status.text: B.Eng Student at HKUST & Engineering with Astrix Rocketry

bio: I'm an undergraduate student in the Department of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering at The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST).
Currently, I contribute as a Junior Engineer in the Astrix Rocketry Team (Aerodynamic & Descent Control), involved in mechanism design, flight recovery systems, and aerodynamic testing.

Beyond rocketry, I have an extensive background in STEM mentorship (1-on-1 tutoring for IB Physics, Economics, and Mathematics AA HL), numerical simulation using Python, and precision 3D CAD modeling with SolidWorks and Fusion 360.

projects.title: Astrix Rocket Aerodynamics & Descent Recovery
projects.description: Mechanism design, aerodynamic load analysis, and control considerations for rocket recovery and descent systems in the HKUST Astrix team.
projects.longDescription: Focused on mechanism design, deployment dynamics, and control considerations for high-altitude recovery and aerodynamic stability under flight conditions.

projects.title: High-Tolerance CAD Mechanical Assemblies
projects.description: Parametric mechanical assemblies and stress-optimized mounting brackets engineered in SolidWorks and Autodesk Fusion 360.
projects.longDescription: Engineered multi-body assemblies with GD&T tolerances, rapid prototyping via FDM/SLA 3D printing, and structural stress validation.

experience.company: Astrix | The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
experience.description: Contributing to the Aerodynamic & Descent Control subsystem for experimental rocketry. Previously a member of the Payload and Descent Control teams, involved in mechanism design, testing, and control considerations for flight and recovery systems.
highlights: Involved in mechanism design and flight recovery system testing for high-altitude rocketry.
Conducted aerodynamic stability analysis and evaluated descent control dynamics.
Collaborated across rocketry sub-teams to ensure system redundancy and recovery readiness.

experience.role: IB Tutor (Physics, Economics, Maths AA HL/SL)
experience.description: Providing personalized 1-on-1 tutoring in IB Physics, Economics, and Mathematics Analysis & Approaches (HL/SL), adapting pedagogical explanations to individual learning styles.
highlights: Designed exam-focused lesson frameworks aligned with IB mark schemes, command terms, and assessment criteria.
Guided students through complex calculus proofs, Newtonian mechanics, and macroeconomic models.

experience.description: Mentored junior students in mathematics through the Math Buddies program, offering weekly structured support to improve understanding of key mathematical concepts.
highlights: Mentored junior cohorts to reinforce algebra, geometry, and foundational numeracy.
Fostered student confidence through personalized diagnostic problem solving.
